title: Lambdas
explanation: A lambda is a function you can hand around like any other value. y -> y < 3 ? "stone" : "glass" is a whole implementation written inline.
It only works where a functional interface is expected - an interface with exactly one abstract method. BlockPicker here is one; java.util.function.Predicate and Function are the standard ones.
The win is that the how becomes a parameter. buildColumn does not know or care which rule it was given, so one method builds every pattern you can describe.
